topics.title: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and director after White House assurances
topics.summary: On November 23, 2026, Nvidia announced that its board of directors voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and board director, ending his 11-day absence. The board cited discussions with Huang and assurances from senior U.S. government officials that his return posed no national security risk, while Nvidia shares surged over 30 percent.

topics.title: OpenRouter drops three inference providers and restricts 125 endpoints following Dragos canary study
topics.summary: On November 22, 2026, AI router OpenRouter off-boarded three inference providers and stripped 125 endpoints of Zero Data Retention eligibility. The decision followed a five-month Dragos study using canary tokens across nearly two million prompts, which detected provider breaches, unauthorized prompt logging by marketplace resellers, and failures to honor privacy policies.

topics.title: Anthropic closes $93.5 billion IPO and $26 billion supplier private placement as tech market sells off
topics.summary: On November 20, 2026, Anthropic closed its initial public offering of 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83 per share, raising $93.5 billion in gross proceeds alongside a concurrent $26 billion private placement of Class N shares to seven tech suppliers. The closing occurred amid a broader global stock market sell-off across AI and tech shares.
